purpose: Teach: 吹か/絵柄/被る/亡き/女将/桶/安物/小豆

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、夏の風を吹かれて気持ち良さそうだったな
lines.en: Riku, you looked way too comfortable standing there with that summer breeze on you.
lines.style: Teasing teen drawl, lazy pace, a smirk audible on 'way too comfortable,' trailing into a knowing 'huh.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、Tシャツの絵柄、つまり絵柄が派手だったな、桜
lines.en: Yeah well, the design on your T-shirt was seriously loud, Sakura.
lines.style: Deadpan comeback, flat delivery with a small punch on 'loud,' tossing her name at the end like a mic drop.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、突然の雨を被るとずぶ濡れになるな
lines.en: You get caught in one of those sudden downpours and you're soaked straight through, seriously.
lines.style: Half-laughing complaint, quick casual pace, exaggerated groan on 'soaked,' shaking her head as she says it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で亡きおじいちゃんのお話してたな、桜
lines.en: Hey, you talked about your late grandpa in social studies, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Tone dips quieter and more careful. Genuine, slightly awkward teen sincerity, softer landing on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のおばさん、女将さんって呼ばれてたな
lines.en: Oh yeah — your aunt, everyone was calling her 'okami-san,' right?
lines.style: Perking back up, bright remembering tone, curious rise on 'okami-san' like she just connected the dots.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お風呂の桶で水遊びしてたろ、桜
lines.en: And you were totally splashing around with the bath bucket, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Gleeful accusation, grin fully audible, pace speeding up to land the 'weren't you' like gotcha evidence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「安物のスニーカーでも気に入った」って言ってたな
lines.en: You literally said, 'They're cheap sneakers but I actually kinda like them.'
lines.style: Mock-quoting him with a lowered goofy imitation voice, then breaking into her own amused tone at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科で小豆煮たな、桜
lines.en: And you boiled adzuki beans in home ec, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Relaxed, winding-down tease, unbothered flat delivery with a small warm chuckle tucked under her name.
